env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd prog
logos run .
stdout '^ok read 2 7 static 5$'
stdout '^ok guarded-ints-fault$'
stdout '^ok guarded-pair-fault$'
stdout '^ok guarded-ptr-fault$'
stdout '^ok guarded-holder-fault$'
stdout '^ok guarded-grouped-fault$'
stdout '^ok plain-write-clean$'
stdout '^ok grouped-plain-clean$'
stdout '^ok guarded-spaced-fault$'
stdout '^ok near-miss-clean$'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- prog/go.mod --
module example.com/rodwritten

go 1.27

-- prog/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

type pair struct {
	n    int
	text string
}

type holder struct {
	p *[4]int
}

var (
	other = 5
	spare = 6
)

//logos:rodata
var guardedInts = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}

//logos:rodata
var guardedPair = pair{n: 7, text: "static"}

//logos:rodata
var guardedPtr = &other

//logos:rodata
var guardedHolder = holder{p: &guardedInts}

var plainInts = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}

var (
	//logos:rodata
	groupedInts = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}

	groupedPlain = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}
)

//logos:rodata 	 
var spacedInts = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}

//logos:rodatax
var nearInts = [4]int{1, 2, 3, 4}

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool, got, want any) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

//go:noinline
func poke(p *int) {
	*p = 9
}

//go:noinline
func repoint(pp **int, q *int) {
	*pp = q
}

//go:noinline
func retarget(pp **[4]int, q *[4]int) {
	*pp = q
}

func child(which string) {
	switch which {
	case "ints":
		poke(&guardedInts[0])
	case "pair":
		poke(&guardedPair.n)
	case "ptr":
		repoint(&guardedPtr, &spare)
	case "holder":
		retarget(&guardedHolder.p, &plainInts)
	case "grouped":
		poke(&groupedInts[0])
	case "groupedplain":
		poke(&groupedPlain[0])
	case "plain":
		poke(&plainInts[0])
	case "spaced":
		poke(&spacedInts[0])
	case "near":
		poke(&nearInts[0])
	}
	fmt.Println("STORE-SUCCEEDED")
}

func run(self, which string) (int, string) {
	cmd := exec.Command(self, "child", which)
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &buf
	cmd.Stderr = &buf
	err := cmd.Run()
	if err == nil {
		return 0, buf.String()
	}
	ee, ok := err.(*exec.ExitError)
	if !ok {
		return -1, err.Error()
	}
	return ee.ExitCode(), buf.String()
}

func checkFault(self, which string) {
	code, out := run(self, which)
	faulted := strings.Contains(out, "unexpected fault address") && strings.Contains(out, "fatal error: fault")
	check("guarded-"+which+"-fault", code == 2 && faulted && !strings.Contains(out, "STORE-SUCCEEDED"), out, "exit 2 with an unexpected fault address")
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 2 && os.Args[1] == "child" {
		child(os.Args[2])
		return
	}
	self, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL executable:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok read", guardedInts[1], guardedPair.n, guardedPair.text, *guardedPtr)
	checkFault(self, "ints")
	checkFault(self, "pair")
	checkFault(self, "ptr")
	checkFault(self, "holder")
	checkFault(self, "grouped")
	gcode, gout := run(self, "groupedplain")
	check("grouped-plain-clean", gcode == 0 && strings.Contains(gout, "STORE-SUCCEEDED"), gout, "exit 0 with STORE-SUCCEEDED")
	code, out := run(self, "plain")
	check("plain-write-clean", code == 0 && strings.Contains(out, "STORE-SUCCEEDED"), out, "exit 0 with STORE-SUCCEEDED")
	checkFault(self, "spaced")
	ncode, nout := run(self, "near")
	check("near-miss-clean", ncode == 0 && strings.Contains(nout, "STORE-SUCCEEDED"), nout, "exit 0 with STORE-SUCCEEDED")
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
